patterns.note: Content is presented in full-width sections, often with centered text blocks and multi-column grids for features, products, or news articles, maintaining a clean, structured flow.
Headings are consistently large and bold sans-serif, providing strong visual hierarchy, while subheadings and labels frequently use an uppercase, slightly smaller variant for categorization.

The palette relies on a high-contrast scheme of dark text on light backgrounds, with various shades of off-white and light grey for section backgrounds, and deep charcoal for text and occasional dark sections.
Hero sections across the site feature full-bleed video backgrounds that play automatically and loop, creating dynamic visual interest and immediately conveying the site's focus on video and AI.
Sections are clearly delineated by alternating background colors (white, light grey, dark grey) and generous vertical padding, creating distinct visual blocks for different content themes.

technique_notes: Hero sections utilize a full-bleed video element set to autoplay and loop, positioned behind a semi-transparent dark overlay to ensure text contrast and readability. The video is often contained within a subtly rounded frame.
Content sections are structured using a flexible grid system, allowing for responsive display of product cards, news items, or feature lists with consistent spacing and alignment.

The primary navigation remains sticky at the top of the page, providing persistent access to key links and calls to action, maintaining a clean, minimal appearance without significant transformation on scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong impact, complemented by legible body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on cards, buttons, and hero video containers, providing a soft, modern feel without being overly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and comfortable negative space around content elements, contributing to a clean and uncluttered aesthetic.

standout: The site's distinctive use of high-quality, often abstract or conceptual video backgrounds in hero sections across multiple pages immediately conveys a sense of innovation and sophistication. This, combined with a clean, editorial layout, elevates it beyond a typical SaaS marketing site, making the technology feel more artistic and cutting-edge.
